author: MLG_Jirafa
body:
I have seen a lot of maps added lately without being tested, there was a map testing stuff past saturday I think but I wasn't on...btw instead of making this events, why you not add the map (without asking anybody) and after a week see the results, if the people like it, then keep it.
Why not to make a nebula rot full of testing maps and maybe add a comand that says vote yes or vote no or stuff like that...I don't know, it would be helpful
